reason: cognee.ai presents Cognee as an open-source memory platform for AI agents ('Memory for Agents, Teams, and People'), shipped as a Python SDK, an MCP server and Cognee Cloud, with integrations for LangGraph, Claude Code and Cursor. Its GitHub README describes turning documents, code and conversations into a knowledge graph plus vector search for agent retrieval. This is an AI-first product built on RAG and agent tooling, so the ai variant fits best.
flags: Cognee is built around knowledge graphs (entities and relationships) and graph stores; Hsan has no knowledge-graph or graph-database experience, so the CV highlights chunking, embeddings, vector search (Qdrant/Pinecone) and the KubeMind correlation agent instead
Cognee's default stack is Postgres/PGVector; neither is in facts.yaml, so the CV shows Qdrant/Pinecone instead
Cognee ships an MCP server and a Rust engine (Cognee-RS); Hsan has no MCP or Rust experience listed
No PFE/internship posting found on cognee.ai; a third-party board (arbeitnow) lists an AI Engineer Working Student role in Berlin, not confirmed on the company site
